name: school-dashboard
description: A local-only personal student dashboard: Blackboard, Gradescope, Qwickly, Gmail and syllabi in one place.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @sd/server & npm run dev --workspace @sd/web

scripts.demo: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/demo.ts
